Amae Health is seeking a dedicated and empathetic Enrollment Specialist to join our team in delivering exceptional care to adults with complex needs. This is a full-time, fully remote role, working Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST. We are currently only considering candidates located in the PST, MST, or CST time zones.
The Opportunity: 
 
The Enrollment Specialist serves as the first point of contact for Amae Health and plays a critical role in creating a lasting, meaningful first impression for prospective patients and their families. As an extension of our care teams, Enrollment Specialists partner closely with patients, families, social workers, and hospital systems to facilitate access to care and support the intake and referral process at Amae Health.
 
What you’ll work on:
Answer inbound calls from potential patients, families, caregivers, hospitals, and social workers.
Review potential members’ Verification of Benefits (VOB) and understand coverage details, including copays, deductibles, and out-of-pocket costs.
Conduct outbound calls to follow up on patient referrals and coordinate with hospitals, social workers, patients, and families.
Engage with social workers to understand patient needs and encourage referrals to Amae Health.
Use clear, articulate communication to convey information about Amae Health’s services.
Schedule and follow up on calls to ensure ongoing communication and referral progress.
Maintain accurate records of interactions and follow-up activities in the CRM system.
Provide compassionate, empathetic support to patients, families, and social workers.
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless referral process and high-quality patient care.
About You:
You are compassionate, empathetic, and comfortable having supportive conversations about complex mental health experiences. You bring high emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and comfort in a phone-based environment. Goal-oriented and resourceful, you follow through to help patients access care at Amae Health and are excited to be part of a collaborative team making a meaningful impact for individuals with severe mental illness.
